description: This file defines interfaces for grain services in an Orleans-based project, including the main grain interface 'IGrainServiceTestGrain' with several method signatures, and an extension interface 'IEchoExtension'.

methods.name: GetHelloWorldUsingCustomService
methods.description: Returns a task that resolves to a string 'Hello World' fetched via a custom service.

methods.name: CallHasStarted
methods.description: Returns a task that indicates whether the grain has started.

methods.name: CallHasStartedInBackground
methods.description: Checks if the background process in the grain has started.

methods.name: CallHasInit
methods.description: Verifies if the grain has been initialized.

methods.name: GetServiceConfigProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration property related to the service.

methods.name: EchoViaExtension
methods.description: Echoes back the provided string via an extension.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Echoes back the input string, provided by the 'IEchoExtension' interface.
